subject.title: [Feature]: expose promptMode parameter in sessions_spawn for deterministic blank sub-agents

question: Should model-callable sessions_spawn expose promptMode, including promptMode="none", or should promptMode remain reserved for trusted lower-level runtime callers?
rationale: The code path is technically clear, but the choice changes the child agent's safety/context envelope and public API surface in a way automation should not decide.

options.title: Approve a constrained promptMode API
options.body: Expose promptMode on sessions_spawn with current defaults preserved, explicit native-runtime semantics, and tests proving task, attachment, and tool-policy behavior under none mode.

options.title: Keep promptMode trusted-only
options.body: Leave promptMode off sessions_spawn and document that blank/raw runs must use trusted lower-level APIs or a future maintainer-owned surface.

options.title: Design a higher-level blank-worker mode
options.body: Add a semantic subagent mode instead of exposing the raw internal enum, trading a larger design step for a safer public contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a constrained promptMode API
recommendation.body: Expose promptMode on sessions_spawn with current defaults preserved, explicit native-runtime semantics, and tests proving task, attachment, and tool-policy behavior under none mode.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced sessions_spawn and has the strongest combined history across the spawn tool and system-prompt surfaces.
